claim.summary: High-incidence occupancy: in the charged character pseudoideal window (edge expansion epsilon, max(4,2Delta) <= D < epsilon n/8), on any graph (multigraphs included), let T be an edge set with |T| = tau, K + tau <= D and 4K < m - tau, and V_hi any vertex set with h = |V_hi|. Let theta be the largest number of edges of T at a vertex outside V_hi and mu the largest number of edges off T joining a vertex outside V_hi to V_hi, with theta + mu < epsilon. With beta_T = 2 sqrt(K/(m - tau)) and eta_hi = 3^h((1 + 2 beta_T^(epsilon - theta - mu))^n - 1), the number q_T(K) of cosets of the cut space plus F_3^T met by the support-K ball satisfies q_T(K) >= 3^(-h)(1 - eta_hi) B_(m-tau)(K), vacuous when eta_hi >= 1. Potentials split into parts on and off V_hi; a nonzero part off V_hi forces a cut meeting (epsilon - theta - mu) times its support of off-T edges, so each coset holds at most 3^h good characters. In a simple graph, V_hi = the vertices with more than theta edges of T gives mu <= h. With V_hi empty it is lem:off-support-occupancy.
